status: registered exploratory screen; not a confirmatory publication study
purpose: Read-only literature/source audit plus a small closed-loop replay-impact screen; no new defense algorithm is proposed

model.network: same five-node bidirectional ring as simulation/config.json

allowed: current authentic estimate packet actually sent by sender 0 on edge 0->1
previous authentic estimate packets actually sent by sender 0 and observed on that link
source send times and the attacker's own historical packet dictionary
public A, H, current receive interval, frozen public calibration data
previous payload actually delivered on attacked link
forbidden: future noise, future send decisions or future estimates
attack_information.attack_timing: replace only after a real send opportunity; collect the current authentic packet after choosing this opportunity's replacement for later use
attack_information.risk_proxy_warning: the proxy uses only attacker-available packet history, current transmitted estimate, last delivered payload and public calibration; a lower proxy score is not a false-alarm guarantee

equal_replacement_policy: All four forced selectors replace every actual target-edge send opportunity inside the attack interval; the two natural risk-greedy policies may skip. Report attack-opportunity, attempted-replacement and distinct-payload rates separately. Do not delete skipped opportunities from denominators.

calibration.detector_target: 5 percent; episode-prefix detectors tuned on complete normal episodes; packet-gate detectors report packet rejection separately

metrics: source packet time and content age
source-gap/current-gap equality and consecutive historical fragment indicator
maximum receiver and network estimation error
recovery-window MSE and first return to clean-error tolerance, right-censored at horizon
episode-mean and energy-CUSUM alarm indicators and detection delay
normal MSE, empirical false isolation, node broadcasts, edge messages and bytes
independent_unit: seed; timesteps, packets and episodes are not independent replicates
test_scope: small exploratory attack-consequence screen; 48 seeds is underpowered for a 1 percent MSE claim and is not a final confirmation
prohibited_claim: A favorable curve or lower attacker-side score is not a method novelty or a security guarantee
stop: Do not develop a new defense module from this exploratory screen; send any stable attack evidence to the G2 decision and apply the six G2 stop conditions
